findings.title: BCM rollback path
findings.detail: avb-installer deactivate --dext bcm57762 submits a deactivation for an extension the new AVBInstaller.app no longer embeds; sysextd will likely reject it as not found. Document `systemextensionsctl uninstall 8NG8NMGYVF com.avbaudio.installer.bcm57762` as the BCM rollback, or drop the --dext bcm57762 form.

findings.title: Inherited Bus Master not cleared in Start
findings.detail: AVBI210Driver::Start sets Memory Space only and never clears an inherited Bus Master bit, so a device left with queues enabled could keep DMAing to dead IOVAs through Stage A. Clear kCmdBusMaster in Start next to the Memory Space set.

findings.title: PHY semaphore held after a fault
findings.detail: setupLink calls phyRelease only when ok(v), so an MDIC READY timeout or all-ones read mid-burst leaves SW_FW_SYNC.SW_PHY_SM set for the next driver. Accept and document it as part of the fault-latch contract, or allow the single release write after a fault.
